title: TheBeast
description: A custom mace inspired by Battle Beast's mace from the show invincible.
body:
**Features**
- Custom legendary mace
- 50% armor penetration
- Bleeding effect
- Bonus air combo damage
- Custom lore and appearance
- Craftable through a configurable recipe

**Drawbacks**

Reduced durability (300 max durability)

**Recipe**

The crafting recipe can be customized in the plugin's configuration file.


![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74693adc4e357c5a1d41c10304d4b9696b826dbc.png)
